name: @backpack-space/client
description: Backpack Space – game client (PixiJS), shipped to iOS/Android with Capacitor. Only shows what the core computes.

scripts.cap:ios: npm run web:build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run web:build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run web:build && cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run web:build && node scripts/with-java21.mjs cap run android
